traditional: the Sun sextile Mars: a soft contact. Vitality, authority, and recognition supports action, conflict, and heat - cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas.
modern: Identity meets drive and aggression. Energy, assertion, and the will to act become central to the sense of self. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Action with little temper behind it. Things get done and the drive feels available rather than volatile. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize selfhood and drive into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what selfhood and drive have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Initiative and drive; the cost is friction with authority and a tendency to force things.
shadow: The ease lets egotism and needing to be the center and anger and recklessness go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.
base: Momentum is easier to find when intention and action point in the same direction.

readerCopy.body: Momentum is easier to find when intention and action point in the same direction. When the Sun sextiles Mars, initiative gets more support, making decisions, conversations, and plans easier to move from consideration into action. The ease is useful, but speed can start looking more convincing than the purpose behind it. Momentum is strongest when the reason is already clear and the remaining problem is execution rather than another round of planning.
